title: CYBRIK investigation v1
description: An investigation record: the unit of correlation for the Claim/Evidence/Bundle triple below it (ADR-0006 E6: investigation_id is required for investigation-scoped payloads). Opened either from a SOC alert (source_ref present; a derived, non-root record) or manually (source_ref absent; a legitimate root record — ADR-0006 E6). identity/tenant fields are written only by authenticated service code; a model can never populate opened_by or tenant_id (ADR-0006). Status: ACCEPTED FOR IMPLEMENTATION (v0.1.0; not stable v1/GA) by explicit Founder Option A and G-W0I01-1..5=yes on 2026-07-26.

objective.description: Optional declared scope/purpose of the investigation (purpose-limitation), e.g. 'triage suspected lateral movement on host X'.

source_ref.description: Digest-bound reference to the SOC alert/case that triggered this investigation, if any. Dereferenced through SOC's authorized API, never inlined (strategy 05 §4.5). Absent for a manually opened (root) investigation.

opened_by.description: Authenticated actor (analyst, service, or agent) that opened the investigation. Written only by authenticated service code.
